title: KDG 2 Pack Cordless Table Lamp, RGB Color Stepless Dimming Up, 4000mAh Battery Operated Portable LED Desk Lamp, for Dinning Room, Bedroom, Bar, Outdoor Garden, Camping, Night Light (Black) Review
reviews: Great lighting! I love these lights! They are very nice looking and put off a lot of light. The charge lasts for a long time. They do take a while to charge.

Great little lamps provide lots of bright light Very happy with the lamps the lights they provide is perfect for small tables or even for the kitchen table. I like the way that their intensity can be changed and you can change from the bright white to the cooler colors perfect as an accent lamp they seem to last a long time on one charge also these differ from others since the part where the lamp screws into the stem is metal and not plastic and therefore it holds up. Lamps are very stable.

These are great lamps I first saw these lamps at my daughter's home, on their dining room table and I thought they really looked good, had several different lighting options and were really well built. When I got home, I did the search and found them right here on Amazon, and no surprise, I ordered them right away. A very good price, I might add. When they finally arrived and I set them up, I really loved the ambiance they gave to my living room and background lighting for my TV. But I did notice that one of the lamps rechargeable batteries ran out about an hour later. So I contacted Amazon and they sent me out a replacement set. But, however it came to be, this new set also had a similar problem with discharging at a different rate than the other. The company always puts their support card in the box the units came in so I reached out to them. They were incredibly helpful and stayed in touch with me at every step of my inquiry. In the end, they sent me a brand new set and told me to keep the older ones, as some small compensation for my earlier disappointments. That kind of generous support is so rare these days. But these lamps. You will not be disappointed!!

Great night lights! We got these for our Labor and Delivery room at the hospital to give birth with. They are so easy to transport and have various brightness levels so it was so great to use there. Now we use it for late night feeds as a bright night light that keeps the room calm and allows baby to go back to sleep easily. Super easy and fast to recharge. Also super cute. Definitely recommend these for a cheap and mobile night light lamp.

Great little outdoor lamps Great little outdoor lamps .. just wish they were a little heavier so of wind were to come .. but we haven’t experienced that yet, but I think it may just tip over . But overall great, very portable and is overall stable , charging was easy and quick . Gives different shades of light that are adjustable.
Cute lamp for small area Works like it says and was easy to assemble.Its a nice lamp for a desk ,side table or hallway area .It's easy to charge.

Nice lamps I’m really happy with this KDG 2-pack. The light output is clear and even, and the 3 color modes make it easy to switch between a crisp bright setting for tasks and a softer tone for relaxing. The stepless dimming is smooth (no jumpy levels), so it’s simple to dial in the exact brightness you want. The cordless/rechargeable design is the biggest win—these are easy to move from room to room, and they work great for a nightstand, patio table, or even camping. The battery life has been solid so far, and it’s convenient not having cords cluttering the space. Build quality feels sturdy for the price, and the black finish looks clean and modern. Overall: clear light, flexible settings, and genuinely portable—a great value as a 2-pack.

Well made & beautiful Love these lamps. They're so sturdy and well-made. Love that they have different settings. We use ours inside and out. Loved them so much that I purchased another set. Great Price.
